title: Artificial Unintelligence
description: Adds Merl, the Minecraft Support Virtual Agent into minecraft!
body:
This datapack adds Merl, the ai chatbot from the Minecraft website, to the game! Merl will spawn in when you first join the world. She is invinsible, and quite... weird, to put it nicely. Upon interation, you can ask her a question, which she will answer... horribly, to but another thing nicely.

As of 1.1, it also adds Minwi, the ai chatbot from the minecraft wiki used during April fools. They will replace Merl half the time when creating a world.

If you find any bugs, please report them to my discord.
